name: r7_walkdescription_repair_038
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path('src/URMatchingWalkDescription.lean');s=p.read_text().replace('simp only [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one]\n        rw','change (i.val + 1 % (k+1)) % (k+1) = i.val+1\n        rw').replace('simp only [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_zero]\n        rw','change (i.val + 1 % (k+1)) % (k+1) = 0\n        rw').replace('rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero, ← heq, hy i] at he','have hyi : p.getVert 1 = .inr (y i) := by simpa only [heq] using hy i\n      rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero, Nat.zero_add, hyi] at he')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),str(p)],input=s,text=True,check=True)
